name: Caltech-101
description: Object classification dataset with 101 categories and about 9,000 images, commonly evaluated with 15- or 30-training-images-per-category protocols. Caltech-256 is a related dataset in the same family.
citation: Fei-Fei, L., Fergus, R., & Perona, P. (2004). Caltech-101: Learning generative visual models from few training examples. IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) Workshop.
